user_saw: Screen-reader users could miss a failed agent-file save or workspace conflict while the draft remained open.
summary: The fix adds alert semantics to agent-file save failure and workspace conflict messages while preserving drafts and recovery controls.
reasoning: PR #135865 introduced the workspace conflict callout as a plain `<div class="callout danger">` and carried forward an ordinary save-error callout that already lacked alert semantics. The later rendering refactors preserved that omission, and the ordinary error callout predates the shallow history boundary, so the available diffs establish the origin of the conflict branch only.
